message:
As a grandparent, I’ve learned that prepping for storms is a bit like herding cats—lots of enthusiasm but not always the best listening skills. I found a resource that helps me keep things organized when the skies start to darken. It’s a practical guide on floods, and it’s packed with info that even the grandkids can understand (if I can get them to stop playing their games long enough). 

So, the next time the weather gets a little too adventurous, I’ll be ready with my list of things to do. Remember, it’s all about keeping calm and carrying on—preferably with some snacks! What’s your go-to tip for getting the kids involved in emergency prep? ☔
